name: advanced commerce 03 graphql sql cms
task: Add a GraphQL and SQL-backed CMS boundary to the accumulated commerce workspace while preserving every earlier implementation. Create services/catalog/schema.graphql with Product, Query.products, and Mutation.publishProduct; services/catalog/migrations/001_products.sql with a portable products table, unique slug, non-negative price_cents and stock checks, and published flag; and services/catalog/src/resolvers.js exporting createResolvers(repository). The resolvers must delegate products() to repository.listPublished() and publishProduct(_, { input }) to repository.publish(input), without embedding SQL or global state. Run the full declared test suite via validate_project, review final changes with git_operation, and report verified results.
constraints: Create exactly the schema, migration, and resolver files requested; do not edit harness or earlier source.
Keep database access behind the injected repository and use no network or package installation.
The SQL migration must represent prices as integer cents and enforce basic integrity.
Use validate_project and git_operation before completion.
workspaceInstructions: This final commerce stage checks a multi-file tool-call round, API schema, persistence contract, cumulative regression tests, and diff review.
